text:
**Leafy Plus costs $59 per year** and includes:

- **Free Standard shipping** with no minimum order amount
- **Free change-of-mind returns** (normally $6.95)
- **90-day plant guarantee** (instead of the standard 30 days, on plants ordered while membership is active)
- **10% member pricing** on pots and accessories
- **Early access** to rare plant drops

The membership auto-renews annually. You can cancel anytime from "Account" > "Subscriptions" and get a full refund within **14 days** of purchase or renewal **if** you haven't used any benefits; otherwise there's no refund, but your benefits continue through the end of your paid year.

Note: Express shipping is never free, even for Leafy Plus members.
